Hyderabad runs on two industrial engines. One is pharma — the Jeedimetla, Patancheru, and Bollaram belt makes Hyderabad one of the world's largest bulk drug and formulation manufacturing hubs, and the Genome Valley life-sciences cluster keeps expanding. The other is IT — HITEC City and Gachibowli have driven a decade of campus construction that shows no sign of slowing. Both economies build constantly, and both need container offices: for plant administrative cabins, construction site offices, security posts, and contractor coordination rooms.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Hyderabad. We build at our own ISO-certified factory in Bangalore and dispatch directly to your Hyderabad site — the pharma belt at Jeedimetla and Patancheru, the IT corridor at Gachibowli and Madhapur, and construction sites across the city. Transit from our factory to Hyderabad is typically 4 to 5 days.

We are the manufacturer, not a reseller. Browse every container office configuration we offer or call us directly.

Why Hyderabad's Twin Economy Needs Container Offices

A container office is a finished steel workspace — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting. For Hyderabad's two main industries, this solves different problems:

Pharma plants in Jeedimetla, Patancheru, Bollaram, and the Genome Valley cluster use container offices as facility-management cabins, contractor offices during plant expansion, security posts at controlled entries, and documentation rooms. When a unit adds capacity or builds a new block, a container office gives the project team a workspace without disturbing the operating plant.

IT campus construction at HITEC City, Gachibowli, and the Financial District relies on container offices for the project manager, site engineers, and security. Hyderabad's continuous commercial construction keeps this demand steady year-round.

General manufacturing and industrial units across the city use them as supervisor cabins, QC rooms, and overflow offices. A modular container office that expands as you grow suits buyers who need to scale workspace in phases.

Hyderabad's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across Hyderabad, including:

Jeedimetla Industrial Area (PIN 500055): One of Hyderabad's major industrial estates on the northern side, dense with pharma, chemical, and engineering units. Container offices here serve as plant cabins, security posts, and contractor offices during expansion.

Patancheru and Bollaram (PIN 502319 / 502325): The heart of Hyderabad's bulk pharma manufacturing belt on the western industrial corridor. Plant construction and capacity addition here drive consistent demand for site offices and administrative cabins.

Genome Valley: The dedicated life-sciences and R&D cluster northeast of the city. Ongoing facility construction in this zone needs site offices and security units for project teams.

HITEC City and Gachibowli (PIN 500081 / 500032): The IT and financial corridor. Campus construction, fit-out, and expansion projects use container offices for site management and gate security.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction and industrial sites across the Hyderabad metropolitan area wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built for a Hyderabad industrial or construction site.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted

Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — keeps the interior workable through Hyderabad's hot, dry summers

Roofing: Container roof with weather sealing, or sloped GI over-roof

Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel

Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load

Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation

Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Hyderabad delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftSecurity cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus meeting or documentation room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Bangalore factory before dispatch.

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Upgraded insulation for Hyderabad's summer heat
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for cooling efficiency
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for outdoor durability
  • Exterior paint and company branding panel

For buyers needing both storage and a workspace in one unit, a storage and office combined in one container is a practical choice for plant and warehouse yards.

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices — most Hyderabad suppliers are dealers reselling units with a markup.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

Pharma plants and industrial buyers who require vendor documentation for a quality audit, GMP facility file, or procurement record can request ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, and GST papers with the order.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and climate-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for long-term outdoor use

Freight from our Bangalore factory to Hyderabad (about 570 km) is quoted as a separate line item. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Hyderabad?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Freight from our Bangalore factory to Hyderabad is added as a separate line. Call +91 88616 22859 with your requirement for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to pharma plants in Jeedimetla or Patancheru?

Yes. We deliver to Jeedimetla (PIN 500055), the Patancheru and Bollaram pharma belt (502319 / 502325), the Genome Valley cluster, the Gachibowli IT corridor (500032), and all Hyderabad industrial and construction addresses. For pharma plant and industrial estate deliveries needing gate-pass or controlled-entry authorisation, share the procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

How long does delivery take from Bangalore to Hyderabad?

Standard sizes are typically ready in 7–12 working days from order confirmation, with transit to Hyderabad of 4–5 days. Custom fit-out with AC, partition, and toilet adds a few working days to production. We confirm dispatch and delivery dates in writing when you order.

Do you provide documentation for a pharma facility audit?

Yes. We supply ISO certificate copies (9001, 14001, 45001), NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST registration as part of your order file. If your facility audit or GMP documentation requires a manufacturer's declaration for installed cabins, request it at order stage and we include it with the delivery paperwork.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Hyderabad — manufactured by SAMAN, delivered to your site:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
